text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen has arrived,
and all
the participants gathered here
are first-rate
racers. The Nakayama
Racecourse is buzzing with
excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here we are at the final of the four races
Fuji
Kiseki set out to challenge, and the
stands are
bursting at the seams with
eagerness!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
I believe in Фудзи Кисэки! I know she can do
this!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Me too! I came here to see her perform
another
miracle!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Do you have a message for the racer
you're
cheering for today?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
Yes! Come on, everyone! Let's channel
some of
our energy to Fuji! Ready, and...
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member A

text_block_list.text: Good luck, Fujiii! You can do iiit!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Members

text_block_list.text:
And, while everyone is waiting on the
edges of
their seats for the race to
begin...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That was such a loud cheer. Thank
you. I
heard it perfectly.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Then she looks directly at me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We've finally made it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Here we are at the finale. The
2,500-meter stage
of the Arima Kinen is
all set.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
This is my final scene. All that remains is
to see
whether it'll conclude with tears
of joy or sorrow...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Do I look radiant to you?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: And how do you see me?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: As the brightest and most beautiful star.

text_block_list.text: ...Right.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'm so glad to have you here.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Well, then... I'm off.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
As I watch her stride off toward the final
race, the
words "Give it your all" echo in
my heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At long last, the curtains rise on the
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
